_description:
Safe-launch preset for Goose CLI. Goose reads ~/.config/goose. Use with: shadictl --policy policies/presets/goose.json --allow ~/.config/goose --allow ~/.local/share/goose --allow ~/.local/state/goose --read /opt/homebrew -- goose

Add your model-provider host to net_allow. On Windows add: --allow %APPDATA%\goose --allow %LOCALAPPDATA%\goose
